name: younss-skills
description: A growing collection of portable agent skills — plain Markdown, no vendor lock-in. Starts with systems-thinking: reasoning about problems and decisions as dynamic systems instead of linear problem-to-solution chains.
author: Younss

scripts.test: node bin/cli.js print > /dev/null && node bin/cli.js install --dir ./.tmp-test --force > /dev/null && test -f ./.tmp-test/systems-thinking/SKILL.md && rm -rf ./.tmp-test && echo ok
